steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Christina, Eastside's most dedicated acting inspector, is back on the case! And today's mystery is...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Wait! What do we have here? Could this be... an antique cipher machine?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: How absolutely thrilling! This is just the kind of puzzle a classy detective should face!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Well, too bad for you, encryptor! You're up against Christina herself. A little cipher like this is no match for me!
